zh.title: 美NTSB公布亞馬遜波音767貨機事故最後飛行資料
zh.summary: 資料顯示飛行員曾增加推力重飛，隨後中止該程序且未部署反推與減速板。
body: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）日前正式公布了2026年9月6日在邁阿密國際機場發生的亞馬遜（Amazon Prime Air）波音767事故之最後30秒關鍵飛行資料。
根據NTSB揭露的資料顯示，飛行員在事故前曾增加推力試圖進行重飛，但隨後中止了該項重飛程序。此外，資料指出飛行員在中止程序後，顯然未能成功部署引擎反推力裝置或是減速板。
NTSB本次公布的資料主要聚焦於該航班最後30秒的飛行狀況。相關單位將持續對這起發生於邁阿密國際機場的波音767事故進行調查。

en.title: NTSB Releases Flight Data From Amazon Boeing 767 Accident At Miami Airport
en.summary: Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 flight data shows pilots aborted go-around at Miami on September 6.
body: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has released the final 30 seconds of flight data from the Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 accident at Miami International Airport, which occurred on September 6, 2026.
According to the newly released information, the data reveals that the flight crew applied engine thrust to initiate a go-around maneuver. However, the pilots subsequently aborted the procedure.

The flight data also indicates that the pilots apparently failed to deploy the aircraft's thrust reversers or speed brakes after aborting the maneuver. The NTSB continues to investigate the circumstances surrounding this Miami International Airport accident.
